name: Non-booked Recovery

named_steps.name: SMS: Non-booked +1m nudge (WF-02)
named_steps.comment: Inline SMS. Members not patients, clinic not office.

named_steps.name: WAIT: +12h to reach 36h mark

named_steps.name: SMS: Non-booked +36h final (WF-02)
named_steps.comment: Inline SMS. Final touch before nurture hand-off.
